content: {"reasoning":"The payer denied CPT 93271 as bundled into another paid service, and the case shows no coding or billing-order error that would support resubmission. Prior authorization and medical necessity are not the issue, so neither retro authorization, peer review, nor a necessity appeal properly addresses CO-97. Because a bundled contractual denial is not patient responsibility, the open balance should be adjusted rather than billed to the patient.","action":"write_off"}
